verdict.rationale: A built-in AI assistant is a fair question for a business banking SaaS like Wise Business, so the axis applies. The evidence pack never mentions an in-product AI assistant or task delegation. The llms.txt probe only shows docs published for LLM consumption, which is an adjacent building block and not an assistant inside the product.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can delegate tasks to a built-in AI assistant inside the product
